full_judgment:
2. Material facts of the case, briefly, are that Mriganka Lal Shaha, the predecessor of the present petitioners as sole plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 29 of 1995 in the Court of the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Additional Court, Shoilkupa, Jhenaidah for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession in the suit land as described in the schedule of the plaint contending, inter-alia, that the property recorded in CS Khatian No. 140 under mouza-Kobirpur measuring an area of 21 decimals was originally owned and possessed by Motilal Shaha, who died leaving wife Protima sundori and only son Monindranath Shaha. The said Motilal Shaha during his lifetime orally gifted his entire property to his son Moninndranath Shaha and to that effect a saf-kobla deed was registered on 29-10-1974. It is pertinent to mention here that the official activities of 13 No. Umedpur Union used to do at Garagong Bazar and in facing the difficulties of performing the functions of Union Parisad at the request of the local elite the plaintiff gave permission to construct Union Parisad building on 2 decimal of land of the suit plot on the condition that after purchase of the land in a suitable place the Union Parisad shall vacate the said 2 decimals of land and shifted their activities to its purchased land. With the permission of plaintiff the then chairman constructed a tin Shed house on the said 2 decimals of land and rest 21 decimals of land remained under the possession of the plaintiff. Thereafter on 30-3-1987 the defendant No. 1, with the help of defendant No. 2 and others denied the title of the plaintiff over the Suit land and illegally by force disposes the plaintiff from the suit land and constructed a building on the southeast corner of the plot. To that effect the plaintiff filed a suit being No. 319 of 1987 on 20-12-1987 but due to some mistake the plaintiff filed an application for return of the plaint of the said suit but the learned Assistant Judge was pleased to reject the plaint of the suit under the provision of Order 7, Rule 11 of the code of civil Procedure. Before 30-7-1987 the defendant never possessed the suit land. There was no title and possession over the non suited plot No-283. Protima Sundori never executed any deed of gift to local Union Parisad. The authority of 13 No. Umedpur Union Parisad illegally disposes the plaintiff from the suit land and hence, the suit. 

 3. Defendant No. 1 contested the suit by filing written statement denying all the material allegations made in the plaint contending, inter-alia, that admittedly the suit land along with non suited land of plot No.283 was originally owned and possessed by Motilal Shaha, who orally gifted his property to his wife Protima Sundori Shaha, she had only one son named Monindranath. Thereafter, Protima Sundori Shaha gifted the suit land along with 1/13 decimal land from non suited plot No. 283 to Umedpur Union Parisad.  It may be mentioned that Protima Shahaa was illiterate and hence he put thumb impression on the said deed and the plaintiff himself was the witness of the said deed. After obtaining the said deed, the union parisad got possession thereon and during RS operation finding the possession of the union Parisad office it was correctly recorded in RS khatian No-105 and the non suited land measuring 1.13 decimal was recorded in RS khatian No. 10, Union Parisad gifted the said non suited plot No. 283 to hospital and a hospital established thereon. The defendant No.1 has been possessing the suit land peacefully uninterruptedly with the knowledge of all concerned including the plaintiff. The plaintiff filed this false suit on false statements of fact and, as such, the suit is liable to be dismissed.
